routes.retired_because: Documentation and comparator presence alone do not prove the exact manuscript kernel or execute a dependency closure. They cannot be the sole certification route; the independent compressed-tag and source bridge proof replaces this shortcut.

C9000113.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 113 (Approximate counting and entropy of perfect matchings.; papers: A Fully Polynomial Randomized Approximation Scheme for Perfect Matchings in General Graphs; Entropy and Face Dimension of the Perfect-Matching Polytope; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/113.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_FPRAS.statement: The manuscript asserts a uniform classical FPRAS for the number of perfect matchings in every finite simple graph, including surely returning zero for graphs without a perfect matching.

L_BALANCED_REDUCTION.statement: Logical balancing, subdivision, deletion accounting, and tree-bag inflation transfer a balanced matching law with polynomial distortion to the tree-bag construction.

L_REPLICATED_SAMPLER.statement: The replicated adjacent-tier chain converts the additive pair-energy comparison into a polynomial-gap sampler with polynomial bit complexity.

C_PAIR.statement: For every permitted tree-bag graph, common activity clamp, and real f1,f2, Var_pi(f1) <= (10^4 N D)^100 E_P(f1(A)+f2(B)) for exactly the manuscript's pair kernel.

L_QUADRANGULATION.statement: The original-cycle fixed label sets admit an odd-arc quadrangulation with a good opposite pair in every cell and good complementary pairs for opposite long arcs.

L_COMPARABILITY.statement: Cell chords, boundary edges, and selected good-side leaf repairs have activity ratio at most 1000D, also under any common clamp.

L_ELEMENTARY.statement: The literal proposal probabilities imply the manuscript's safe-switch, color-change, and discrepancy-cycle energy bounds, with the factor 1/2 in the Dirichlet form.

L_CELL_IDENTITY.statement: For arbitrary real matching functions, the signed cell identity and complementary-arc cancellation give D_C = sum_cells(Delta+E_P-E_Q), retaining nonzero context errors.

L_ENCODING.statement: Switch and two-context error demands admit legal colored matching encodings whose product weights differ by at most (1000D)^4 and whose tagged inverse has a polynomial number of preimages.

L_CONDITIONAL_MASS.statement: For each fixed directed colored arc identity X and first matching A, error-demand mass is at most (1000D)^4 T pi(A) p_X; conditional Jensen cancels p_X exactly.

L_SWAP_SUM.statement: Every long closed-arc swap is an entire discrepancy component; each oriented pair/component has at most 2N arc identities, giving Sigma_swap <= 12N^2 E.

C_PAIR_IMPROVED.statement: For every manuscript tree-bag graph, common activity clamp, and real f1,f2, the exact manuscript kernel satisfies Var_pi(f1) <= 44040192 N^12 (1000D)^6 E_P(f1(A)+f2(B)); the same structural theorem holds for the locally repairable quadrangulation class defined in research/pair_energy_audit/proof.md.

C_COMPACT_TAG.statement: The actual switch and two-context error encodings have an injective inverse tag with eight vertex slots, eight binary color slots, and at most 384 flags, so every output fibre has at most 2^17 N^8 demands, including colored-edge multiplicities.

C_PAIR_CORE.statement: The Lean declarations in PairEnergyAudit prove the compact finite tag cardinality and injective-fibre implication, finite nonnegative weighted-centering inequality retaining guide mass, two-context and swap scalar identities, abstract demand-energy composition, compact-coefficient identity, and domination by the manuscript headline coefficient; they do not formalize the graph-to-encoding bridge.

C_UPSTREAM_SCOPE.statement: Upstream commit 4eaee87548250b2682affda7d05d947c05554bae documents FPRAS/entropy formalizations and comparator declarations. This campaign neither executed that closure nor treats documentation as a proof of the exact manuscript kernel.

C_ENTROPY.statement: For every loopless multigraph on 2m >= 2 vertices and every feasible perfect-matching marginal x, including boundary points, F(x)-(2-2/m)B(x) <= H(x) <= F(x).

L_FACE_CODIMENSION.statement: For the minimal matching face at a positive feasible marginal, |E|-dim(F_x) <= 3m-2; on supported coordinates the analogous bound holds after deleting zero coordinates.

L_ENTROPY_TRACE.statement: At a local maximum of J_c-H with every coordinate strictly fractional, the face covariance calculation gives 0 >= dim(F_x)-|E|+(c+1)m.

L_ENTROPY_BOUNDARY.statement: The minimal-face exponential family, entropy continuity, and removal of fixed coordinates extend the entropy argument to every boundary marginal.
